sloka: सो ऽहं निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्विज्ञातायुर्द्विजोत्तम ।कालधर्मं हृदि न्यस्य ततो वनमुपागमम् ।। ७.७८.७ ॥
transliteration: so 'haṁ nimitte kasmiṁścidvijñātāyurdvijottama ।kāladharmaṁ hṛdi nyasya tato vanamupāgamam ।। 7.78.7 ॥

translations.english: O best of Brahmanas, having known my lifespan due to some cause, I then accepted the law of time in my heart and went to the forest.
